verdict: approve scoped G09 navigation/focus source component
review: Inspected all three production diffs and changed tests before the implementer packet. Six-file scope contains presentation/navigation plus existing tests only; no transaction/custody/SDK or monetary-intent logic change.

Capture records first visible public post and viewport offset plus post-scoped link focus. Restore fetches displaced pages within the existing single20s abort deadline, retains snapshot revision/scope/checkpoint and duplicate/cursor defenses, restores exact offset, and announces a missing anchor instead of using a stale pixel.

Return search has a time bound and existing response-size/cursor guards rather than a new numeric page cap. An arbitrarily distant or missing anchor may reach the deadline and render failure; this is explicitly unqualified, not an infinite background loop. Automatic paging retains its single in-flight owner and abort/stale-route checks.

Explicit Load more captures focus ownership before disabling. On success it focuses first appended item or empty terminal status; on error a visible alert. It will not overwrite focus moved elsewhere during the request. Automatic paging never invokes the explicit focus handoff.

Dialog re-render matches control tag/label and occurrence, not private input values. Same connected controls remain focused; missing/disabled matches fall back to section heading or Close. work captures the active control before temporary disabling, retaining asynchronous profile-selection focus.
Wallet work/catch/finally still uses existing invalidation, error handling and render. No preparation, confirmation, submission, fee limit, durable state, consent or retry call was added or removed.
Existing narrow390px navigation, unsafe-content, failure/retry, paging reorg/revision/duplicate/cursor/empty-loop and saved-position scenarios were included in independent selected checks.
